Robot.Title: AIMeE Bot
Robot.Description: Designed by - presumably drunk - Norsec roboticists, AIMeE (or Automated Independent Mechanical Entity) can be a Stationeer's best friend, or tiresome nemesis, or both several times in the same day. Intended to unearth and retrieve ores automatically, the unit requires basic programming knowledge to operate, and Editor de IC. AIMEe has 7 modes: RobotMode.None = 0 = Do nothing RobotMode.None = 1 = Follow nearest player RobotMode.None = 2 = Move to target in straight line RobotMode.None = 3 = Wander around looking for ores in 15 co-ords radius RobotMode.None = 4 = Unload in chute input or chute bin within 3 meters / 1.5 large grids RobotMode.None = 5 = Path(find) to target RobotMode.None = 6 = Automatic assigned state, shows when storage slots are fullSe conecta a Transmisor lógico

StructureAdvancedComposter.Title: Advanced Composter
StructureAdvancedComposter.Description: The advanced composter creates Fertilizer out of organic matter. It accepts food, Decayed Food or Biomasa. It requires Agua and power to operate, accelerating the natural composting process. When processing, it releases nitrogen and volatiles, as well a small amount of heat. Compost composition Fertilizer is produced at a 1:3 ratio of fertilizer to ingredients. The fertilizer's effects on plants will vary depending on the respective proportions of its ingredients. - Food increases PLANT YIELD up to two times - Decayed Food increases plant GROWTH SPEED up to two times - Biomasa increases the NUMBER OF GROWTH CYCLES the fertilizer lasts for up to five times

Agrizero.Title: Agrizero
Agrizero.Description: Agrizero es una empresa de biotecnología agrícola centrada en la investigación y el despliegue de tecnología agrícola fuera del mundo. El objetivo de la compañía es proporcionar una red de 'bio-fábricas' autosuficientes y autónomas que, en última instancia, alimentarán a un millón de seres humanos en el espacio. Tras emerger de los desastres medioambientales de finales del siglo XXI, la empresa tiene sus raíces en las iniciativas de agricultura artificial que salvan al mundo de China y ahora se ha extendido a instalaciones en el Cinturón de Asteroides, donde el suministro de asteroides de hielo hace que la agricultura vertical y la agricultura de ambiente controlado sean extremadamente prometedoras. Si bien muchas de sus instalaciones aún están en construcción, Agrizero ya es uno de los principales proveedores de grupos externos como ODA, Sinotai y ExMin a través de la Red de comerciantes en constante expansión.

GasWater.Title: Agua
GasWater.Description: You can obtain water by smelting or crushing Trozo de hielo using a Horno or an Rompehielos. Agua is critical for plants to stay alive, and grow food. It is also an exceptional coolant with a very high specific heat capacity. Agua will evaporate into Steam if it's temperature is raised above its boiling point.

Asura.Title: Asura Biomedia
Asura.Description:
Asura Biomedia fue fundada a principios del siglo XXII por el trillonario de Mumbai Ashan Gurwaja. Centrada nominalmente en la "biotecnología", la compañía siempre ha tenido una noción "elástica" de lo que eso implicaba exactamente: todo, desde productos farmacéuticos hasta comida para mascotas.
La experiencia de Gurwaja en empresas de bioingeniería colocó a la empresa en el más alto nivel de las industrias de las ciencias biológicas desde el principio, y creció exactamente como su fundador pretendía: de forma rápida y fiable, estructurada específicamente para absorber cualquier empresa más pequeña que se interpusiera en su camino.
Cerca de mediados de siglo, las ambiciones de Asura evolucionaron hasta abarcar sistemas de salud enteros: ahora es el mayor proveedor de atención sanitaria de la Tierra, integrando los hospitales y la atención primaria con los suministros médicos, la producción y venta al por menor de productos farmacéuticos, la atención residencial y los servicios funerarios.
En 2150, el negocio de Asura era una simple propuesta, como se refleja en su famoso, si no infame, eslogan publicitario: "Estamos en ti".

CHAC.Title: CHAC
CHAC.Description: Fundada en 2085 para producir armas para las fuerzas espaciales de Sinotai, la compañía es conocida por fabricar armas altamente fiables y asequibles para su uso en el exterior. Su enfoque pragmático se refleja en su enfoque en los diseños adecuados para la impresión en 3D y la producción en masa, así como una alta reutilización de los componentes a través de los modelos y las clases de armas. Como resultado, aunque las armas CHAC no sobresalen en ninguna categoría en particular, y ciertamente nunca han sido acusadas de ser anticuadas, no sufren grandes fallos, y funcionan lo suficientemente bien según la mayoría de las medidas conocidas como para haber ganado a sus diseñadores el título informal de "armero del Sistema Solar".

CableNetworkPage.Title: Cable Networks
CableNetworkPage.Description: When placing cables with Моток кабеля you create cable networks. These contain volatile memory that can be read or written to using a Микропроцессор IC10. This includes a variety of special logic variables such as Channel0 through to Channel7. The networks also have readable memory, which contains a list of all the data devices on the network, and can be used with GET to find the ReferenceId for that device. To find out the current quantity of devices in the stack, use the StackSize variable on the network, as the network adjusts its stack size dynamically based on devices within it. Cable Networks are volatile memory, and will change both their order, contents, and data whenever the network changes - so you may need to constantly poll and update the information. To access this, use extra notation on your device references such as d0:1 to access network 1 off the provided device. To find out the connection number, check the stationpedia page for that device for the number under the connections section.
CableNetworkPage.Text:
When placing cables with {THING:ItemCableCoil} you create cable networks. These contain volatile memory that can be read or written to using a  {THING:ItemIntegratedCircuit10}. This includes a variety of special logic variables such as {LOGICTYPE:Channel0} through to {LOGICTYPE:Channel7}. The networks also have readable memory, which contains a list of all the data devices on the network, and can be used with GET to find the {LOGICTYPE:ReferenceId} for that device. 
	  
To find out the current quantity of devices in the stack, use the {LOGICTYPE:StackSize} variable on the network, as the network adjusts its stack size dynamically based on devices within it. Cable Networks are volatile memory, and will change both their order, contents, and data whenever the network changes - so you may need to constantly poll and update the information.  

To access this, use extra notation on your device references such as {COLORYELLOW:d0}:{COLORYELLOW:1} to access network 1 off the provided device. To find out the connection number, check the stationpedia page for that device for the number under the connections section.

StructureCombustionCentrifuge.Title: Combustion Centrifuge
StructureCombustionCentrifuge.Description: The Combustion Centrifuge is a gas powered version of the Centrifugadora. If a Recicladora or unbalanced Horno outputs reagent mixture rather than the desired ingots, a centrifuge allows you to reclaim the raw ore. It also refines Dirty Ore produced from the Deep Miner and Dirty Ore produced from the Rocket Miner. A combustible fuel mix should be supplied to the gas input, and waste gasses should be vented from the output. The machine's RPMs must be controlled via the throttle and combustion limiter levers. If the Combustion Centrifuge gains, or loses, RPMs too fast it will experience stress, and eventually grind to a halt. Higher RPMs directly result in faster processing speeds. The throttle lever controls the amount of fuel being pulled into the machine, increasing the temperature inside the engine, and leading to an increase in RPM. The limiter lever influences the speed of the combustion, and how much uncombusted gas is in the exhaust. Ejecting ore from the Combustion Centrifuge while it is at high RPMs will result in additional stress build up. If turned off while not stressed, the machine will automatically start to brake, and reduce RPMs in a controlled manner.

DecayedFood.Title: Decayed Food
DecayedFood.Description: When your food decays, it turns into this. ODA scientists have attempted to determine the exact constituents of this substance, but it remains evasive and mysterious. Suffice to say, eating it is a bad idea. Research has determined, however, that The exact speed of decay varies individually by: - TEMPERATURE - Refrigeration will slow decay, but many foods will be damaged by exposure to extreme low pressure, as well as extreme heat. The optimum temperature is 0 kelvin (-272 C). - FOOD TYPE - Each food type has its own decay properties. Sopa de Tomate lasts a lot longer than a Tomate, for instance. - PRESSURE - Food decays faster when the pressure drops below 1 atmosphere (101kPa). Decay happens exponentially more quickly as the atmosphere approaches a perfect vacuum. There is no effect from higher pressures. - ATMOSPHERE - Different gases can slow and accelerate the decay process. The process will take account of respective gas ratios in mixed atmospheres in calculating the decay modifier. The following rates apply across all foods: > Oxigeno x 1.3 > Nitrogeno x 0.6 > Dióxido de carbono x 0.8 > Volátil x 1 > Contaminante x 3 > Óxido Nitroso x 1.5 > Steam x 2 > Vacuum (see PRESSURE above)

StructureEvaporationChamber.Title: Evaporation Chamber
StructureEvaporationChamber.Description: A device for safely evaporating liquids into gasses. Liquids and Gasses will both exist safely inside the device. Lowering the pressure target of the in-built back pressure regulator using the setting wheel will change the boiling temperature of liquids inside. The secondary gas input on the left is a heat-exchanger input and allows for heat exchange between the secondary input pipe and the internal atmosphere of the Evaporation Chamber. Paired with Condensation Chamber Stationeers can exploit the phase change properties of gases to build a DIY air conditioner.

ExMin.Title: ExMin
ExMin.Description: A raíz del desastre de Sísifo en Marte en 2079, el ODA prohibió oficialmente el desplazamiento de asteroides. Este cambio radical obligó a la recién nacida industria de la minería espacial a reconsiderar sus estrategias, pero hasta la apertura del Ascensor Espacial de Manaus, la economía marginal significaba que la extracción de recursos fuera del mundo era efectivamente imposible. Formado en 2095 por un conglomerado minero suizo-alemán de larga estancia y un consorcio de otros intereses, ExMin fue más una idea que una realidad comercial durante varias décadas. Creado con la certeza de que eventualmente llegaría un ascensor espacial, ExMin fue uno de los primeros en explotar el acceso que ofrecía. Posteriormente se ha convertido en una de las entidades comerciales más poderosas del Sistema Solar. Con el acceso al espacio seguro, ExMin se convirtió en un actor central en el flujo de recursos al sistema interno. Tiene competencia, principalmente del gigante minero brasileño Recurso, pero la empresa nunca ha perdido por completo su liderazgo en la minería fuera del mundo. Sinónimo de metales de tierras raras y pionera en la extracción de recursos fuera del mundo, se encuentra a la vanguardia del desarrollo en todo el Sistema Solar.

StructureExpansionValve.Title: Expansion Valve
StructureExpansionValve.Description: Allows for moving liquids from a liquid pipe into a gas pipe. Only allows liquids to pass in one direction. Typically this is done to allow the liquid to evaporate into a gas as part of an airconditioning loop.

StructureFridgeBig.Title: Fridge (Large)
StructureFridgeBig.Description: The Xigo Koolaid fridge is a self-cooling storage device with 15 slots that preserves food when powered and turned on. While many users have complained about the placement of the power switch, its place in the pantheon of off-world whiteware is unquestioned. With its own permanent internal atmosphere, the Koolaid fridge slows the decay of food by maintaining an optimal internal temperature. Its power usage varies on the external temperature against which it must balance its internal temperature. As such, it must shed heat to operate, so the Koolaid fridge DOES NOT work in a vacuum. Also, don't leave the door open, as it will equalize with the current world temperature. And maybe start to beep. For more information about food preservation, visit the food decay section of the Stationpedia.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Kit (Fridge Large)

GeFabrik.Title: GeFabrik
GeFabrik.Description:
Oficialmente conocida como Gewehrfabrik GmbH, GeFabrik es una de las firmas de armamento más antiguas y respetadas del mundo, conocida por producir armas de fuego de alta gama excepcionalmente precisas.
A raíz del colapso de la fabricación de armas europea en la década de 2030, un grupo de personal de armamento desempleado formó GeFabrik. Dedicada a renovar los principios de diseño originales, la compañía es legendaria por sus extensas pruebas, que a veces duran hasta 10 años, para producir formatos de armas "ganz".
Se considera que GeFabrik ha salvado por sí solo la reputación de fabricación de Alemania, sin hacer nada por su sentido del humor.

Hiiragi.Title: Hilragi
Hiiragi.Description:
Fundada por Noboru Hiiragi a raíz de la burbuja económica de la década de 2110, Hiiragi Communications absorbió varios activos destacados fuera del mundo, convirtiéndose rápidamente en la red de comunicaciones trans-solar más utilizada.
Si se ha comunicado con amigos y familiares fuera del mundo recientemente, ha sido a través de la red de Hiiragi, incluso si tiene la marca de una de sus muchas empresas secundarias. Hiiragi es también el vendedor número uno de PCD (dispositivos de comunicación personal), así como un inversor profundo, aunque difícil de evaluar, en redes de telecomunicaciones terrestres.

ItemNitrice.Title: Ice (Nitrice)
ItemNitrice.Description: Nitrice is the nickname given to solid Nitrogeno Ice, and found on many planets and moons in the Solar System. Given the inert nature of the Nitrogeno it produces, the ice is useful when making breathable atmospheres with low flammability. Highly sensitive to temperature, nitrice will begin to melt as soon as it is mined, unless the temperature is below zero, or it is stored in the Cinturón Minero, Cinturón minero (Avanzado) or devices like the Rompehielos or Fridge Small.

StructureRoboticArmDock.Title: LArRE Dock
StructureRoboticArmDock.Description: The Linear Articulated Rail Entity or LArRE can be used to plant, harvest and fertilize plants in plant trays. It can also grab items from a Chute Export Bin and drop them in a Contenedor con Tolva. LArRE can interact with plant trays or chute bins built under a linear rail station or built under its dock.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Kit (LArRE)

StructureLarreDockAtmos.Title: LArRE Dock (Atmos)
StructureLarreDockAtmos.Description: The atmospherics LArRE can pump gas into and out of its storage canister. When lowered over a Ventilación Pasiva, the atmospherics LArRE will connect with it and pump gas into and out of the connected pipe network. Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by. The base atmospheric logic values point to LArRE's internal gas storage. The Input atmospheric logic values point to the grid that LArRE is in OR the pipe network that LArRE is docked to via a Ventilación Pasiva

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Kit (LArRE Dock Atmos)
Destornillador 2 x Partes Electrónicas

StructureLarreDockBypass.Title: LArRE Dock (Bypass)
StructureLarreDockBypass.Description: The bypass dock allows LArRE arms to move off the main rail so that others may pass. Pressing activate on a dock while its arm is at a bypass will cause the arm to move into the bypass' off-rail position.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Kit (LArRE Dock Bypass)
Destornillador 2 x Partes Electrónicas

StructureLarreDockCargo.Title: LArRE Dock (Cargo)
StructureLarreDockCargo.Description:
The cargo LArRE can take things out of and put things into slots on devices. The dial on the front panel indicates which slot on the device to interact with. The slot variables of the item in the target slot can be read using the Proxy Slot Index (255)

Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Kit (LArRE Dock Cargo)
Destornillador 2 x Partes Electrónicas

StructureLarreDockCollector.Title: LArRE Dock (Collector)
StructureLarreDockCollector.Description:
The collector LArRE can suck up nearby loose items when its mode is set to inward and eject stored items when its mode is set to outward. When set to suck up items, the collector LArRE will automatically stop and retract when full. 

Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Kit (LArRE Dock Collector)
Destornillador 2 x Partes Electrónicas

StructureLarreDockHydroponics.Title: LArRE Dock (Hydroponics)
StructureLarreDockHydroponics.Description:
The hydroponics LArRE can plant and harvest plants as well as place fertiliser into plant trays. It has an additional hopper slot which will feed items into the 'hand' slot when the hand slot is empty. Harvesting a different plant while the hand slot is full will be possible if the hopper slot is empty. In which case the plant in the hand will be moved into the hopper slot and the new plant will be harvested into the hand slot.
        The slot variables of a plant in the plant tray below can be read using the Proxy Slot Index (255).
Pressing the activate button while the LArRE arm is at its home dock will move the arm off the main rail. This allows other arms on the same rail to pass by.

BuildStates.Description: 1 x Kit (LArRE Dock Hydroponics)
Destornillador 2 x Partes Electrónicas

LogicStepSequencer8.Description: The ODA does not approve of soundtracks or other distractions. As such, Stationeers have had to create their own musical accompaniment to the demanding labor of building and maintaining off-world infrastructure. Central to this pastime is the step sequencer, which allows Stationeers to sequence short musical patterns or loops. DIY MUSIC - GETTING STARTED 1: Connect 8 Device Step Units to your step sequencer via the data port on the left hand side. 2: Label each step unit, then assign step units 1 through 8 on the step sequencer using the screwdriver. 3: Select the output speaker (eg Passive Speaker) where the sequencer will play the sounds. This needs to be connected to the logic network on the right hand side of the sequencer. 4: Place a Stop Watch and use a Lector Lógico and Grabador Lógico to write the time to the time variable on the sequencer. 5: Set the BPM on the sequencer using a Dial and a Grabador Lógico to write to the sequencer's BPM variable. A higher bpm will play the sequence faster. 6: Insert a sound cartridge of your choosing and select which variant of sound you wish to play by pushing the arrow buttons located above and below the sound cartridge slot. 7: Choose the pitch of the sounds to play by setting the dial on each of your 8 step units to the desired note. With drums, each note is a different drum sounds. You can trial your sounds by pushing the activate button on each step unit (with the sequencer inactive). 8: Get freaky with the Low frequency oscillator. 9: Finally, activate the sequencer, Vibeoneer.

DeviceLfoVolume.Title: Low frequency oscillator
DeviceLfoVolume.Description: The low frequency oscillator (or LFO) makes everything sound dark, twisted and crunchy by altering the shape of the waves output by a Logic Step Sequencer. To set up an LFO: 1. Place the LFO unit 2. Set the LFO output to a Passive Speaker 2. Set a sequencers' output to LFO - so the sequencer's signal runs through the LFO to a speaker. 3. Place a Stop Watch or use an existing one, then use a Grabador Lógico to write it to the LFO. 4. Use another logic writer to write the BPM to the LFO. 5. You are ready. This is the future. You're in space. Make it sound cool. For more info, check out the music page.

GasNitrogen.Title: Nitrogeno
GasNitrogen.Description: Nitrogeno can be mixed with Oxigeno to stabilize its flammability and avoid Oxigeno toxicity, and is a resource in its own right, useful for creating, a breathable atmosphere (at roughly 3:1 Nitrogeno and Oxigeno). The most efficient source of Nitrogeno is from Ice (Nitrice) deposites found around the Solar System. You can Condense Nitrogeno into Liquid Nitrogen by lowering its temperature below its boiling point.

StructureNitrolyzer.Title: Nitrolyzer
StructureNitrolyzer.Description: This device is used to create Óxido Nitroso from Oxigeno, Nitrogeno, and a large amount of energy. The process does not completely transform all the available gas at once, so the output is a mix of all three gasses, which may need further processing. More NOS will be created, if the gas inside the machine is close to a 1/1 ratio of Oxygen to Nitrogen. The second gas input line in optional, and not required if the gas is pre mixed.

Norsec.Title: Norsec
Norsec.Description: Con sus raíces en la industria de defensa de principios del siglo XX, Norsec (también conocido como Northern Security Systems) fue uno de los primeros en adoptar la minería de asteroides: uno de sus remolcadores estuvo involucrado en el infame Sísifo Hit en la incipiente colonia marciana en Sanders. Norsec fue oficialmente absuelto de cualquier mala conducta, pero cuando ODA prohibió la reubicación de asteroides, la compañía cambió su enfoque hacia la infraestructura y la fabricación. La División de Sistemas Espaciales de Norsec, con base orbital, es responsable del diseño y producción de los sistemas de transporte centrales de ODA, aunque también se rumorea que tiene un gran interés en ExMin. La compañía también se destaca por su disposición a participar en tecnología robótica experimental.

ODA.Title: ODA
ODA.Description: A raíz de la Crisis de la Tierra, el enfoque de la humanidad en el espacio disminuyó. Sin embargo, muchos sintieron que, sin ambiciones más allá de nuestro planeta de origen, nuestra especie podría flaquear. Creada en 2070 EC por Naciones Unidas recientemente renovada, la Agencia de Desarrollo Offworld recibió un objetivo muy específico: guiar y alentar la exploración espacial humana en un momento en que el cosmos se estaba desvaneciendo de la mente del público. Inauguró el programa Stationeer en 2095. Entendiendo que sería difícil conseguir financiación, la ODA concibió el programa como una iniciativa espacial de bajo consumo y de combustión lenta. Mientras que algunos se burlaron de Stationeers como 'náufragos cósmicos de precio reducido', el éxito del programa es testimonio de la sabiduría y el pragmatismo de la visión de ODA.

StructureHorizontalAutoMiner.Title: OGRE
StructureHorizontalAutoMiner.Description: The Recurso OGRE (Orthogonal Ground Rotating Excavator) is a base structure with attached mining vehicle, which will mine a horizontal shaft up to X meters long. When full, the mining vehicle will return to the base to empty itself, before returning to dig. If it encounters empty space, it will also return to base and await instruction. The unit will return if deactivated. The OGRE can be connected to a chute system, and is controllable by a logic network. Note that the OGRE outputs more ore than a conventional Taladro Minería over the same area, due to more efficient processing. MODES Idle - 0 Mining - 1 Returning - 2 DepostingOre - 3 Finished - 4

AppliancePlantGeneticAnalyzer.Title: Plant Genetic Analyzer
AppliancePlantGeneticAnalyzer.Description: The Genetic Analyzer can be used to process samples from the Plant Sampler. Once processed, the genetic information of the sampled plant can be viewed by clicking on the search button. Individual Gene Value Widgets: Most gene values will appear as a sliding bar between a minimum value on the left and a maximum value on the right. The actual value of the gene is in the middle of the bar, in orange. Multiple Gene Value Widgets: For temperature and pressure ranges, four genes appear on the same widget. The orange values underneath the bar are the minimum and maximum thresholds for growth. Outside of this range, the plant will stop growing and eventually die. The blue values underneath the bar are the minimum and maximum thresholds for ideal growth. Inside of this range, the plant will grow at maximum speed. The white values above the bar are the minimum and maximum achievable values for the growth threshold.

HowToBuild.Description: 4500 x Energy 1 x Gold from Lingote (Oro) 5 x Copper from Lingote (Cobre) 5 x Steel from Lingote (Acero)

AppliancePlantGeneticSplicer.Title: Plant Genetic Splicer
AppliancePlantGeneticSplicer.Description: The Genetic Splicer can be used to copy a single gene from one 'source' plant to another 'target' plant of the same type. After copying, the source plant will be destroyed. To begin splicing, place a plant or seed bag in the left slot (source) and place another plant or seed bag of the same type in the right slot (target). You can select a gene using the arrow buttons. Close the sliding door and press the green activate button. Once splicing has begun, the device will be locked until the process has finished (which will take approximately twenty minutes). If you want to cancel splicing you can power off the bench or detach the appliance as a last resort.

AppliancePlantGeneticStabilizer.Title: Plant Genetic Stabilizer

Stabilize: Increases all genes stability by 50%. Destabilize: Decreases all gene stability by 10% other than a chosen gene which will received decreased stability by 50%.

PortableComposter.Title: Portable Composter
PortableComposter.Description: A simple composting device, the basic composter creates Fertilizer out of organic matter. It accepts food, Decayed Food or Biomasa. It requires a full Liquid Canister and a battery to operate, accelerating the natural composting process. When processing, it releases nitrogen and volatiles, as well a small amount of heat. Compost composition Fertilizer is produced at a 1:3 ratio of fertilizer to ingredients. The fertilizer's effects on plants will vary depending on the respective proportions of its ingredients. - food increases PLANT YIELD up to two times - Decayed Food increases plant GROWTH SPEED up to two times - Biomasa increases the NUMBER OF GROWTH CYCLES the fertilizer lasts for

Or you could use a Llave Inglesa to attach it to a rocket and take it somewhere distant and dry, then feel good about yourself.

Recurso.Title: Recursos Espaciales
Recurso.Description: Este grupo minero brasileño de larga estancia se ramificó en el espacio a fines del siglo XXI. Centrada principalmente en minerales y metales a granel, la compañía quizás se entienda mejor como una extensión del gobierno brasileño: muy pocas figuras políticas del escalón superior en el Brasil moderno no están implicadas en un brazo u otro de este gigante industrial. El enredo con la política sudamericana le ha dado a la compañía una gran influencia sobre el ascensor espacial de Manaus. Este profundo control estatal ha llevado a otros grupos el ODA incluido a ejercer cierta "flexibilidad" hacia el Recurso. Las acusaciones de reubicación ilegal de asteroides, violaciones de seguridad y numerosas infracciones comerciales apenas lo han tocado. Mientras tanto, los defensores señalan que se ha probado muy poco en los tribunales, y Recurso no está solo, de ahí la obviedad: "En el espacio, todos vivimos en casas de cristal".

StructureRefrigeratedVendingMachine.Title: Refrigerated Vending Machine
StructureRefrigeratedVendingMachine.Description: The refrigerated OmniKool vending machine is an advanced version of the standard Máquina expendedora, which maintains an optimum pressure and constant temperature of -130 degrees C, to prevent food spoilage. It can hold up to 100 stacks. The OmniKool also has an in-built Apilador, allowing players to set the stack sizes of any items ADDED to the device. The unit's default stack size is 50. NOTE: altering stack sizes DOES NOT update existing stacks within the machine, only those subsequently added.

Sinotai.Title: Sinotai
Sinotai.Description: La única entidad estatal 'tradicional' que sobrevivió a la política exterior, el alcance y el poder de Sinotai es superado solo por el ODA en sí. En muchos sentidos, una reliquia, una sub-agencia de una burocracia corporativa asombrosamente complicada ligada a la Tierra, su estructura le ha permitido a Sinotai lograr cosas increíbles. Demostrando su valía a principios del siglo XXI al colocar a los primeros humanos en Marte, establecer el primer sistema de energía de gigavatios fuera del mundo y la primera refinería de combustible espacial, pocas organizaciones espaciales carecen de algún grado de relación con Sinotai. Una broma común dice que es imposible hacer algo en el espacio sin ellos. Independientemente de la verdad, el enfoque de Sinotai para el desarrollo fuera del mundo ha involucrado un enfoque de 'poder blando', de MOU con Recurso (dándoles acceso preferencial al espacio de Manaus ascensor) a alianzas de conveniencia más turbias con una variedad de grupos de comerciantes.

There are a variety of cautions to the design of electrical systems using batteries, and every experienced Stationeer has a story to tell, hence the Stationeer adage: 'Dianzi cooks, but it also frys.' POWER OUTPUT Able to store up to 3600000W of power, there are no practical limits to its throughput, hence it is wise to use Bobina de Cable (Grueso). Seasoned electrical engineers will also laugh in the face of those who fail to separate out their power generation networks using an Control de Energía and Transformador (Grande).

Stationeers.Title: Stationeers
Stationeers.Description: A principios del siglo 22, la Tierra estaba emergiendo de un cataclismo. Sus recursos se erosionaron, nuestra población se redujo, la reconstrucción era el espíritu de la época. Iniciado por la Agencia de Desarrollo Offworld (ODA) en 2095CE, el Programa Stationeers se dedicó a un solo ideal: mantener a la humanidad apuntando a las estrellas. Los Stationeers lo son todo: astronautas, ingenieros y exploradores, desplegados con equipos y herramientas limitados, entrenados para hacer más con menos. Aprovechando el medio ambiente, su trabajo consiste en proporcionar infraestructura para los humanos en el espacio, a una fracción del costo de los programas espaciales tradicionales. Capaces de construir y mantener bases en cualquier lugar, desde la Luna hasta Mimas y más allá, Stationeers son nuestra vanguardia en el cosmos. Formados en supervivencia fuera del mundo, técnicas de minería y construcción, metalurgia básica, electrónica, cohetería, hidroponía y más ciencias "arcanas", los Stationeers hacen lo que deben para sobrevivir y prosperar. Reconocido por no tener criterios de entrada, no existe un Stationeer "típico". El perfil psicológico sugiere que los cadetes exitosos muestran un pragmatismo "básico" y una determinación, pero algunos de los Stationeers más famosos no poseen ninguna de estas cualidades. Reclutando personas con experiencia en ingeniería civil, industrias militares y aeroespaciales, desarrollo de software, grupos mineros, así como campos científicos e incluso órdenes religiosas, el Programa Stationeers está, fundamentalmente, abierto a toda la humanidad.

StructureStirlingEngine.Title: Stirling Engine
StructureStirlingEngine.Description: Harnessing an ancient thermal exploit, the Recurso 'Libra' Stirling Engine generates power via the expansion and contraction of a working gas to drive pistons operating an electrical generator. When high pressure hot gas is supplied into the input pipe, this gas will heat the hot side of the unit, then pass into the output pipe. The cooler side uses the room's ambient atmosphere, which must be kept at a lower temperature and pressure in order to create a differential. Add a working gas by inserting a Bombona. The unit must be deactivated when adding or removing canisters, or the working gas may leak into the surrounding atmosphere. Gases with a low molecular mass make the most efficient working gases. Increasing the moles of working gas can result in a greater potential power output. However, overpressuring the unit may have... sub-optimal results.

Xigo.Title: Xigo
Xigo.Description:
Una encuesta de 2150CE reveló que Xigo 'X' es uno de los símbolos más reconocidos del mundo. Sin embargo, pocos participantes pudieron describir claramente el alcance real de la empresa.
Precisamente el lugar donde comienza y termina la empresa ha sido objeto de un sinfín de teorías, estudios financieros y demandas: originalmente un sitio web para comparaciones de precios, el conglomerado se expandió para abarcar datos, luego distribución y finalmente producción.
Fue una expansión aparentemente indiscriminada, centrada no en una industria, sino en todas, abarcando tantos campos que los analistas de negocios han rechazado en gran medida la idea de Xigo como una sola entidad. Más bien, es una agrupación conceptual para una rama de la actividad humana. Y aunque tales estadísticas son, por su propia naturaleza, difíciles de confirmar, estimaciones recientes sugieren que Xigo emplea a más del 1,5% de toda la raza humana.
Basta decir que produce casi todo.

WeatherPage.Title: Weather
WeatherPage.Description: The Solar System's planets are not as calm as they may seem. After seven days on any world with an atmosphere, the inscrutable forces of nature swing into action – hitting unwary Stationeers with blizzards, dust storms and volcanic events. As such, the ODA recommends that freshly deployed Stationeers create an airtight base within 7 days of landing. Any dynamic objects left outside in a storm – on Mars, Loulan, Vulcan or Europa – risks being blown far, far away, including your lander. Likewise, be aware that solar panels are fragile and may have their glass shattered, or occasionally even be destroyed by a sufficiently ferocious storm. During storms, their output is also drastically reduced.
WeatherPage.Text:
The Solar System's planets are not as calm as they may seem. After seven days on any world with an atmosphere, the inscrutable forces of nature swing into action – hitting unwary Stationeers with blizzards, dust storms and volcanic events.

As such, the {LINK:ODA;ODA} recommends that freshly deployed Stationeers create an airtight base within 7 days of landing.

Any dynamic objects left outside in a storm – on Mars, Loulan, Vulcan or Europa – risks being blown far, far away, including your lander.

Likewise, be aware that solar panels are fragile and may have their glass shattered, or occasionally even be destroyed by a sufficiently ferocious storm. During storms, their output is also drastically reduced.

ConstructionPage.Title: Construction
ConstructionPage.Description: Getting Started Typically you will use kits to initiate construction and then a variety of tools and resources to complete. Pay close attention to how many of your kit are required to construct what you have selected, as some structures require more than one of the stack to be consumed. For some kits you will have multiple options, use the Scroll Wheel to change the current option you are looking to build. Build States Some structures will have multiple build states that require different combinations to complete. Your tooltip will advise you of what combination you need to complete the structure. Sometimes you will need to have two objects, one in each hand, to complete a build state. Some tools will need to be turned on first, which can done by pressing O while it's in your active hand. Tooltips If you look directly at a structure that is incomplete you will get information about what you need to do to complete it. If you have a tool in your hand and its not the right tool, a tooltip will appear telling you what you would need to use to deconstruct it. Pressure When building, it's important to note that pressure is measured as a differential. Most structures have a 200kPa pressure limit: if the difference between inside and outside is greater than that, you've got problems.

EVAPage.Title: EVA Suits
EVAPage.Description: Your spacesuit provides you with a portable atmosphere, with adjustable pressure and air conditioning (temperature) settings, as well as an warning system that will alert you should the atmosphere inside the suit become hazardous. It functions in conjunction with a suitable helmet to function properly, as well as suitable gas canisters and filters in the suit's various slots. These will need to be changed regularly, and can also be recharged (or drained) using a Stojan na oblek. There are several suits, including the Skafandr and the more pressure- and temperature-resistant Zpevněný oblek. Your suit various readouts are at the bottom-right of the screen. Pressing the appropriate numeric key (2will bring up a panel showing its slots and settings. These include: - A/C On / Off (i.e. Temperature control on/off) - Filters On / Off - Air On / Off - Pressure Up / Down (with a range of 0kPA to 202kPa, or 0-2 Earth atmospheres) - Temperature Up / Down (with a range of 0°C to 60°C) Suits contains 6-8 slots: - Air tank (x1) - insert a canister or smart canister containing a breathable gas mix, eg Kyslík or Dusík/Kyslík 35/65. - Waste tank (x1) - collects gases removed by the filters - Life support (x1) - holds one battery, which powers your A/C, lights, etc. - Plynový filtr (x3) - requires at least one Filtr (oxid uhličitý) (if human), depending on your breathable gas mix. Note that a Zpevněný oblek has 4 filter slots. - IC - Zpevněný oblek only. Pressure: should be set to 50-100 KPa (0.5 to 1 Earth atmospheres). Humans in-game tolerate up to ~250kPa and can survive up to ~300kPA. Temperature: normally set to 18-21°C, with humans in-game preferring 10-29°C, tolerating 0-39°C and surviving around up to 49°C. In higher temperatures, your A/C will consume more battery power to maintain internal temperature. Filters: the default filter is the Oxid uhličitý filter, which captures the gas generated by humans when breathing out. If you are not using 100% Kyslík in your breathing gas, add additional filters, eg if you mix 25% Kyslík + 75% Dusík, the nitrogen will accumulate in your suit over time and suffocate you, unless you have a nitrogen filter. If you have the correct filters and breathable gas, but are still experiencing problems, use the 'Flush' function on your Space Helmet. Low/critical oxygen warnings will sound as your filters cease to function. If damaged, your suit can be patched by holding duct tape in your hand and using 'activate' button.
EVAPage.Text:
Your spacesuit provides you with a portable atmosphere, with adjustable pressure and air conditioning (temperature) settings, as well as an warning system that will alert you should the atmosphere inside the suit become hazardous. It functions in conjunction with a suitable helmet to function properly, as well as suitable gas canisters and filters in the suit's various slots. These will need to be changed regularly, and can also be recharged (or drained) using a {THING:StructureSuitStorage}.

There are several suits, including the {THING:ItemEvaSuit} and the more pressure- and temperature-resistant {THING:ItemHardSuit}.

Your suit various readouts are at the bottom-right of the screen. Pressing the appropriate numeric key (2will bring up a panel showing its slots and settings. These include:

- A/C On / Off (i.e. Temperature control on/off)
- Filters On / Off
- Air On / Off
- Pressure Up / Down (with a range of 0kPA to 202kPa, or 0-2 Earth atmospheres)
- Temperature Up / Down (with a range of 0°C to 60°C)

Suits contains 6-8 slots:
- Air tank (x1) - insert a canister or smart canister containing a breathable gas mix, eg {GAS:Oxygen} or {GAS:Nitrogen}/{GAS:Oxygen} 35/65.
- Waste tank (x1) - collects gases removed by the filters
- Life support (x1) - holds one battery, which powers your A/C, lights, etc.
- {SLOT:GasFilter} (x3) - requires at least one {THING:ItemGasFilterCarbonDioxide} (if human), depending on your breathable gas mix. Note that a {THING:ItemHardSuit} has 4 filter slots.
- IC - {THING:ItemHardSuit} only.

Pressure: should be set to 50-100 KPa (0.5 to 1 Earth atmospheres). Humans in-game tolerate up to ~250kPa and can survive up to ~300kPA.

Temperature: normally set to 18-21°C, with humans in-game preferring 10-29°C, tolerating 0-39°C and surviving around up to 49°C. In higher temperatures, your A/C will consume more battery power to maintain internal temperature.

Filters: the default filter is the {GAS:CarbonDioxide} filter, which captures the gas generated by humans when breathing out. If you are not using 100% {GAS:Oxygen} in your breathing gas, add additional filters, eg if you mix 25% {GAS:Oxygen} + 75% {GAS:Nitrogen}, the nitrogen will accumulate in your suit over time and suffocate you, unless you have a nitrogen filter. If you have the correct filters and breathable gas, but are still experiencing problems, use the 'Flush' function on your Space Helmet. Low/critical oxygen warnings will sound as your filters cease to function.

If damaged, your suit can be patched by holding duct tape in your hand and using 'activate' button.

DecayPage.Title: Food Decay
DecayPage.Description: Food decays over time into Decayed Food, unless refrigerated in a sutable atmosphere. The exact speed of decay varies individually by: - TEMPERATURE - Refrigeration will slow decay, but many foods will be damaged by exposure to extreme low pressure, as well as extreme heat. The optimum temperature is 0 kelvin (-272 C). - FOOD TYPE - Each food type has its own decay properties. Rajčatová polévka lasts a lot longer than a Rajče, for instance. - PRESSURE - Food decays faster when the pressure drops below 1 atmosphere (101kPa). Decay happens exponentially more quickly as the atmosphere approaches a perfect vacuum. There is no effect from higher pressures. - ATMOSPHERE - Different gases can slow and accelerate the decay process. The process will take account of respective gas ratios in mixed atmospheres in calculating the decay modifier. The following rates apply across all foods: > Kyslík x 1.3 > Dusík x 0.6 > Oxid uhličitý x 0.8 > Těkavé látky x 1 > Znečišťující látka x 3 > Oxid dusičitý x 1.5 > Voda x 2 > Vacuum - see PRESSURE (above).
DecayPage.Text:
Food decays over time into {THING:DecayedFood}, unless refrigerated in a sutable atmosphere. The exact speed of decay varies individually by:

- TEMPERATURE - Refrigeration will slow decay, but many foods will be damaged by exposure to extreme low pressure, as well as extreme heat. The optimum temperature is 0 kelvin (-272 C).

- FOOD TYPE - Each {LINK:OrganicPage;food} type has its own decay properties. {THING:ItemTomatoSoup} lasts a lot longer than a {THING:ItemTomato}, for instance.

- PRESSURE - Food decays faster when the pressure drops below 1 atmosphere (101kPa). Decay happens exponentially more quickly as the atmosphere approaches a perfect vacuum. There is no effect from higher pressures. 

- ATMOSPHERE - Different gases can slow and accelerate the decay process. The process will take account of respective gas ratios in mixed atmospheres in calculating the decay modifier. The following rates apply across all foods:

> {GAS:Oxygen} x 1.3
> {GAS:Nitrogen} x 0.6
> {GAS:CarbonDioxide} x 0.8
> {GAS:Volatiles} x 1
> {GAS:Pollutant} x 3
> {GAS:NitrousOxide} x 1.5
> {GAS:Water} x 2
> Vacuum - see PRESSURE (above).

FarmingPage.Title: Growing Food
FarmingPage.Description: To survive on alien worlds, the ODA expects all Stationeers to set up viable hydroponic systems, or contact registered local resource traders. SETTING UP When setting up your hydroponic system, you will need seeds. Alternatively, you can plant the food itself. Common Stationeer hydroponic equipment includes: - Přenosná hydroponie - Hydroponická nádoba (sada) - Hydroponická stanice (sada) - Harvie All hydroponics systems require water, sunlight and the correct gas mixture - plants require Oxid uhličitý and produce oxygen (except for Mimozemská houba). PLants will not grow in the wrong atmosphere. If plants do not have enough light, you will need to build a Růstové světlo. Your system will depend on available resources and time, but a well-designed farming system can be almost fully automated given sufficient time and resources. HARVESTING Most plants have several growth stages. The first stages are the plant growing through its lifecycle. During the third phase, seeds may be harvested from the plant. In the fourth phase, the plant will yield fruit. After that, unless cleared, the plant will die. FERTILIZER Fertilizer alters plant growth processes, and is created by the Portable Composter and the Advanced Composter using organic matter. Fertilizer's affects depend on its ingredients: - Food increases individual PLANT YIELD by up to 3 items - Decayed Food increases plant GROWTH SPEED up to 3 times - Biomasa increases the NUMBER OF GROWTH CYCLES the fertilizer lasts for to a maximum of 5 The effect of these ingredients depends on their respective proportions in the composter when processing is activated. Fertilizer is produced at a 1:3 ratio of fertilizer to ingredients. When processing, Dusík and Těkavé látky is released, as well a small amount of heat.

NutritionPage.Title: Hunger and nutrition
NutritionPage.Description: HUNGER Stationeers get hungry eventually, but not all food is created equal. Also, your hunger rate varies depending on settings and difficulty. Eating will only consume that part of an item adequate to restoring your hunger to 100%. Stationeers receive supplies of food such as Agrizero Cereální tyčinka in their lander upon arriving on a new world. When these are exhausted, you must find new sources of sustenance - such as growing your own, from the seeds supplied, or contacting a Trader. NUTRITION Eating raw ingredients will satisfy hunger less than meals, ie will replace a smaller proportion of your hunger. The basic elements of food are created using hydroponics systems. These can be processed into recipe ingredients using the Zpracovatel činidel, then turned into meals using a Mikrovlnná trouba or Automated Oven. Your hunger rate can be adjusted set in the main settings menu by adjusting the Hunger/Hydration rate slider in the settings. Note that the hunger slider also governs your Thirst.

MusicPage.Title: Making Music
MusicPage.Description: The ODA does not approve of soundtracks or other distractions. As such, Stationeers have had to create their own musical accompaniment to the demanding labor of building and maintaining off-world infrastructure. Central to this pasttime is the step sequencer, which allows Stationeers to sequence short musical patterns or loops. DIY MUSIC - GETTING STARTED 1: Connect 8 Device Step Units to your step sequencer via the data port on the lefthand side. 2: Label each step unit, then assign step units 1 through 8 on the step sequencer using the screwdiver. 3: Select the output speaker (eg Passive Speaker) where the sequencer will play the sounds. This needs to be connected to the logic network on the righthand side of the sequencer. 4: Place a Stop Watch and use a Čtečka logiky and Zapisovač logiky to write the time to the time variable on the sequencer. 5: Set the BPM on the sequencer using a Číselník and a Zapisovač logiky to write to the sequencer's BPM variable. A higher bpm will play the sequence faster. 6: Insert a sound cartridge of your chosing and select which variant of sound you wish to play by pushing the arrow buttons located above and below the sound cartidge slot. 7: Choose the pitch of the sounds to play by setting the dial on each of your 8 step units to the desired note. With drums, each note is a different drum sounds. You can trial your sounds by pushing the activate button on each step unit (with the sequencer inactive). 8: Get freaky with the Low frequency oscillator. 9: Finally, activate the sequencer, Vibeoneer.
MusicPage.Text:
The {LINK:ODA;ODA} does not approve of soundtracks or other distractions.
As such, {LINK:Stationeers;Stationeers} have had to create their own musical accompaniment to the demanding labor of building and maintaining off-world infrastructure.
Central to this pasttime is the step sequencer, which allows Stationeers to sequence short musical patterns or loops. 

{HEADER:DIY MUSIC - GETTING STARTED}

1: Connect 8 {THING:DeviceStepUnit}s to your step sequencer via the data port on the lefthand side.

2: Label each step unit, then assign step units 1 through 8 on the step sequencer using the screwdiver.

3: Select the output speaker (eg {THING:PassiveSpeaker}) where the sequencer will play the sounds. This needs to be connected to the logic network on the righthand side of the sequencer.

4: Place a {THING:StopWatch} and use a {THING:StructureLogicReader} and {THING:StructureLogicWriter} to write the time to the time variable on the sequencer.

5: Set the BPM on the sequencer using a {THING:StructureLogicDial} and a {THING:StructureLogicWriter} to write to the sequencer's BPM variable. A higher bpm will play the sequence faster. 

6: Insert a sound cartridge of your chosing and select which variant of sound you wish to play by pushing the arrow buttons located above and below the sound cartidge slot.

7: Choose the pitch of the sounds to play by setting the dial on each of your 8 step units to the desired note. With drums, each note is a different drum sounds. You can trial your sounds by pushing the activate button on each step unit (with the sequencer inactive).

8: Get freaky with the {THING:DeviceLfoVolume}.

9: Finally, activate the sequencer, Vibeoneer.

TemperatureControlPage.Title: Temperature Control
TemperatureControlPage.Description: In order to control the temperature of a system, we have to either add heat to it thus increasing its temperature or remove heat from it thus cooling it down, that's the basic idea of temperature control. Devices that achieve this goal for you are Nástěnné topení (sada), Nástěnný chladič (sada), Potrubní radiátor, and Klimatizace. NOTE: There are many methods of temperature control. Some involve none of the devices mentioned. Here, we are covering the basics. It is important to understand your environment before you install any type of temperature control. The gas or liquid volume is an important factor to when choosing your method of temperature control. A Malá nádrž can hold up to 6000L, while a Velká nádrž can hold up to 50,000L, which means that if both are full, the small tank will react faster to temperature changes. A room is a space that can hold a certain amount of gas. The bigger it is the more volume it will be able to hold, so the same rules generally apply to tanks and rooms. PIPE NETWORKS A pipe network is one or more pipe segments connected to each other with no separation at any point. A pipe network shares the same atmosphere everywhere along the pipe, no matter how large it is. If you change the temperature or pressure at one end of the network, the furthest end will experience the same change immediately with no delay. Adding devices to a network may split it into two different networks. For instance, adding a Objemové čerpadlo to a pipe network will split the network into two networks: one before the pump, and one after it. Use the Kapesní tablet with the Atmosférický analyzátor installed to see information about the contents of any pipe network. RADIATORS Manufactured in the pipe bender, a Potrubní radiátor will help you exchange heat between pipes and their surrounding environment. They work on both insulated pipes and pipes, as well as having liquid variants. In normal conditions a pipe segment will exchange heat with its surrounding environment, but adding a radiator to that pipe segment will speed up the process greatly. A pipe segment will keep exchanging heat with the surrounding atmosphere until both equalize in temperature. PASSIVE COOLING You can cool or heat any environment by using a Potrubní radiátor to exchange heat between two atmospheres. An example of this would be to place a pipe on the wall, fill it with gas, and place radiators on the pipe. Now the two atmospheres of the pipe and the room will exchange temperature until their environments equalize. WALL HEATER The Nástěnné topení (sada) is a simple device that can be installed on a wall or a frame and connected to power. When switched on, it will start heating the surrounding environment. It consumes 1010W of power and can be controlled by logic chips to run when the temperature hits a certain level. WALL COOLER The Nástěnný chladič (sada) complements the wall heater, which can only raise the temperature. The wall cooler functions by drawing heat from the surrounding atmosphere and adding that heat into its pipe network. In order to run the wall cooler properly, you will need to connect pipes to the wall cooler and fill the connected pipe network with any type of gas. The gas's heat capacity and volume will determine how fast it reacts to temperature changes. The higher the difference in temperature between the gas stored in the pipes and the room, the less efficient the wall cooler will be. So to keep the wall cooler running at an acceptable efficiency you will need to get rid of the heat that accumulates in the pipes connected to it. A common practice would be to run the pipes to the outside and use radiators on the outside section of the pipes to get rid of the heat. The less efficient the wall cooler, the less power it consumes. It will consume 1010W at max efficiency. The wall cooler can be controlled by logic chips to run when the temperature hits a certain degree. If the wall cooler is flashing an error then it is missing one of the following: - Pipe connection to the wall cooler. - Gas in the connected pipes, or pressure is too low. - Atmosphere in the surrounding environment or pressure is too low. AIR CONDITIONER The Klimatizace in its basic form works just like the wall cooler and can benefit from the same designs. However it is more powerful. It cools faster and uses considerably more power depending on the situation, thus making it more suitable to deal with large volumes and large areas. It can heat or cool depending on the setting. AIR CONDITIONER: HOW IT WORKS The air conditioner has 3 pipe connections (Input, Output, Waste). Gas goes in through the input side, then, depending on the setting, heat is added or removed from the incoming gas, and added to the waste pipe. The output gas will then exit through the output connection, cooler or hotter depending on the setting. You can connect the input pipe to the output pipes (you can see if they are connected if they both have the same network number): this will give you more control over the temperature, since the gas won't reach the target temperature after the first pass. It will take time and energy to remove or add heat from any gas. The way you install and set up your air conditioner depends on what you are trying to cool or heat up. For a room, you will need a passive vent inside the room connected to the air conditioner's input and output, while the waste pipe has to be filled with a coolant gas. The air conditioner does not have to be inside the room. The only part of this setup that has to be in the room is the passive vent which will circle the room's atmosphere through to the air conditioner to be cooled or heated. You can use a single air conditioner to do both heating and cooling. You just need to change the target temperature setting on the panel. However, if you want to automate cooling and heating at the same time you will need one air conditioner for cooling and another one for heating, because the setting on the panel can only be changed manually. Setting up more than one air conditioner on the same pipe network can be useful if you need things to go faster or if you need to use some for heating and others for cooling. Do this by connecting the inputs and the outputs of the air conditioners together and having them all share the same pipe network for their inputs and outputs. The waste pipe network can also be shared between them, but it has to be separate from the input/output pipe network. The same idea applies when using the air conditioner to control the temperature of tanks. However, instead of using a passive vent, you will need to connect the tank to the air conditioner directly. AIR CONDITIONER: KEEP IN MIND - The greater the difference in temperature between the input pipe and the waste pipe, the more power the air conditioner will use - The power consumed by the air conditioner can exceed 5kW, therefore using heavy cables to power up air conditioners is recommended. - Running the waste pipe outside and equalizing it with the outside atmosphere isn't always the best option: the gas you put inside of it can be applied somewhere else in your base. AIR CONDITIONER: BASE TEMPERATURE CONTROL There are many ways to control the temperature of your base using air conditioners - this is one way of achieving this goal: Step 1: Run a single pipe network around your base, and install passive vents connected to this pipe in every room you wish to be controlled by this setup. This is 'Network A' Step 2: Connect 'Network A' to an air conditioner's input and output. Step 3: Connect the waste pipe to a different network, and run it to the outside. Install radiators on this network. This is the basic setup. To automate it you will need a pipe analyzer on Network A, then read the temperature and run your air conditioner(s) accordingly. Good luck, Cadet!

HydrationPage.Title: Thirst + Hydration
HydrationPage.Description: Your average Stationeer needs to drink water regularly. However, arcane and possibly misguided ODA health and safety regulations have long denied Stationeers the right to in-suit hydration mechanisms. Instead, they must take regular drink breaks to open their helmet, and imbibe water. Doing so in an unpressurized environment is unadvised. How often to drink? This is determined by your difficulty level, the heat of the planet and how much you like to move your body. Water comes in many forms. At least one Láhev na vodu is supplied to Stationeers as part of their rations when landing on new planets, with more in your lander crates. These can be refilled using a Plnička lahví na vodu, which must itself be connected to a liquid pipe network. The network itself can be filled using a Drtič ledu with a suitable supply of ice. Your thirst rate can be adjusted set on the main settings menu by adjusting your Hunger/Hydration rate slider.

GeneticsPage.Description: Plants have a set of Genes that modifies their behavior. A plant's genes will be manipulated in a number of ways, both naturally as well as artificially. When a plant produces fruit or seeds it will pass on its genetics with a small random mutation. On top of random mutations, a plant's condition over its life can also affect its genes - for example if a plant is starved of water, while it may affect the plants growth speed and yield, the offspring will receive genes that make it require less water. In this way you can manipulate your crop's ideal conditions. There are a number of tools you will need to manage your crops effectively: Plant Sampler and Plant Genetic Analyzer. These tools allow you to sample a growing plant and see the state of its genes. Plant genetics is not an exact science and will require trial and error and repeated attempts before you are able to reach your targets.

AutomatedRocketPage.Description: Rocket parts are printed on the Rocket Manufactory. Fuselage (Type A1) must be built upon a Launch Mount. A Pumped Gas Engine must be placed in an Engine Mount (Type A1). Resource Umbilicals are placed on the Launch Tower and connect between Umbilical (Gas) and Umbilical Socket (Gas) placed inside the rocket. A Počítač with the Rocket Control Motherboard provides a user interface to control the rocket. A Pair of datalinks are used to create a planet-side Logic Uplink and a rocket-side Logic Rocket Downlink which must be hooked up to the Počítač. An Rocket Avionics should be placed in the rocket to act as the main rocket controller. On the Rocket Control Motherboard Map Screen you can set the rocket destination. Igniting the rocket without a destination set allows you to see rocket performance and fuel usage without launching the rocket. Expect to use 5-20Kmol of fuel per rocket trip, depending on rocket size. A Rocket Scanner is used to chart unknown locations and discover minable asteroids. More complex rockets may use Rocket Miner and Cargo Storage (Small).
AutomatedRocketPage.Text:
Rocket parts are printed on the {THING:StructureRocketManufactory}.

{THING:StructureFuselageTypeA1} must be built upon a {THING:StructureLaunchMount}. A {THING:StructureGovernedGasEngine} must be placed in an {THING:StructureEngineMountTypeA1}.

Resource Umbilicals are placed on the {THING:StructureRocketTower} and connect between {THING:StructureGasUmbilicalMale} and {THING:StructureGasUmbilicalFemale} placed inside the rocket.

A {THING:StructureComputer} with the {THING:MotherboardRockets} provides a user interface to control the rocket.

A Pair of datalinks are used to create a planet-side {THING:StructureLogicRocketUplink} and a rocket-side {THING:StructureLogicRocketDownlink} which must be hooked up to the {THING:StructureComputer}.

An {THING:StructureRocketAvionics} should be placed in the rocket to act as the main rocket controller.

On the {THING:MotherboardRockets} Map Screen you can set the rocket destination.

Igniting the rocket without a destination set allows you to see rocket performance and fuel usage without launching the rocket.

Expect to use 5-20Kmol of fuel per rocket trip, depending on rocket size.

A {THING:StructureRocketScanner} is used to chart unknown locations and discover minable asteroids.

More complex rockets may use {THING:StructureRocketMiner} and {THING:StructureCargoStorageSmall}.

TradingPage.Description: Trading is an essential part of a Stationeers existence, especially on more extreme worlds, where new cadets may be challenged at first to survive without assistance. There are three separate tiers of contacts. These contacts have increasing difficulties to contact, and hang around for about 20 minutes before they leave and another one takes their place, so you’ll have to find the harder contacts if you want to check out many traders. Contacts must be resolved by the dish before it can determine how accurately it is pointed at the contact. The time to resolve is determined by the dish's power output multiplied by the dish alignment, over the contact’s expected resolve wattage. If the contact is resolving too slowly, it likely indicates you are not close to the target at all, and you should try a very different angle. Alternately, the contact might have a very high expected wattage, and your current dish just isnt big enough to resolve it in a reasonable time. The resolving process only uses 10% of the actual power your dish is set to. Once you have resolved the contacts position, you’ll be able to press the interrogate button. Similar to resolving, you’ll need to land enough wattage on the contact. The interrogation dialog will inform you of the current calculations. Interrogation does have a hard minimum, and if the dish is not pointed well enough, or the power is too low, you won't be able to start the process. Interrogation also has a time requirement, with harder contacts taking significantly longer, so you’ll want to use high wattages to ensure you finish before the trader moves on. Once interrogation is complete, you can land the trader just as before.
